newsitem.title: SYRIA: Delegation of Israeli Arabs to visit Syria.
newsitem.headline: Delegation of Israeli Arabs to visit Syria.

text.p: A delegation of 50 Israeli Arabs, including seven members of the Israeli parliament, will start a visit to Syria on Thursday, Palestinian sources said on Monday.
They said the delegation will meet with Syrian officials and Palestinian groups to discuss developments in the Middle East.

The delegation, headed by Iirahim Nemer Hussein , an independent MP, will come to Damascus via Cairo and will stay for eight days, Ali Badwan, spokesman of the Democratic front for the Liberation of Palestine (DFLP) told Reuters.
"They will discuss with the Palestinian leadership the situation in the occupied lands ... And peace process in the Middle East and the continuous setbacks caused by the Israeli policies," he said.
